headline: NYers LIED 💨 to about TOXIC ☣️ Air after 9/11 🏙️
text:
NEW 🗽 YORKERS straight up got LIED 🤥 to about breathing in that POISON ☠️ air after the 9/11 🏢 towers came CRASHING 💥 down says Zohran MAMDANI 🗣️ who just DROPPED 📤 a massive 170000 📑 document NUKE 💣 on City Hall 🏛️!! Asbestos 🧱 was literally EVERYWHERE 🌫️ tested near GROUND ZERO 🕳️ while officials were out here playing DOWN ⬇️ the health RISKS 😷 to the public like it was no big DEAL 🤥!! "People got SICK 🤢 because the leaders they TRUSTED 🫡 lied and told them they were SAFE 🛡️ to breathe in TOXIC ☣️ air" he SPILLED ☕ while announcing the release that proves they KNEW 🧠 all along and still let folks get absolutely COOKED 🧪!! Illnesses from the dust ☁️ and smoke have now claimed MORE than THREEFOLD 3️⃣ the nearly 3000 ☠️ lives lost in the attacks themselves according to US health officials who are finally admitting the body COUNT 📈 is still CLIMBING 🧗‍♂️!!

TV HOST 📺 and 9/11 survivor ADVOCATE 🦸 Jon Stewart stood RIGHT 🫡 beside Mamdani at Tuesday's NEWS 📢 conference and SNAPPED 🫰 that the new files show the city KNEW 🕵️ by October 2001 that Manhattan air was straight TOXIC ☣️!! "So to be FAIR ⚖️ to them they only BURIED 🪦 that information for 25 YEARS 🕰️" he said with MAXIMUM ☢️ sarcasm while the crowd sat there ABSOLUTELY FLOORED 😵!! Records prove asbestos 🧱 hung around GROUND ZERO 🕳️ for MONTHS 📅 while people were being TOLD 📢 it was perfectly SAFE 🟢 to go back and start LIVING 🏠 their lives again!! The files include air quality REPORTS 📊 and internal CHATS 💬 among city officials that paint a picture of total COVERUP 🕵️‍♂️ from the very beginning bro!!

That October 2001 HARDING 📝 MEMO straight up WARNED ⚠️ former Deputy Mayor Robert Harding that the city could get hit with UP TO 35000 🧾 legal CLAIMS ⚖️ for how they handled the response after the attacks!! The document literally STATES 📜 that health advisories caused people to RETURN 🏃‍♂️ to the area too soon causing TOXIC ☣️ exposure or emotional HARM 💔 and they knew it the whole TIME ⏰!! City officials were also telling citizens to just CLEAN 🧹 up the dust and debris with wet mops 🧽 and rags 🧺 even though asbestos 🧱 is supposed to be handled ONLY by LICENSED 🪪 professionals according to another memo that called out Congressman Jerry Nadler’s CONCERNS 😟!!

The memo from Ester Fuchs special adviser to Mayor Michael BLOOMBERG 🌼 at the time admitted there were "potential PROBLEMS ❌ for City Hall" after their top health official testified that a study found "no elevated levels" of asbestos in indoor air but then tests showed dust had low levels in some SAMPLES 🧪 anyway!! Days after the attack both city and federal officials including the EPA 🟦 literally DECLARED 📣 that the air near the Twin Towers was SAFE 🟢 which we now know was a COMPLETE 🤥 lie that got thousands of people DEATHLY ☠️ sick!! Christine Todd Whitman who ran the EPA back then later APOLOGIZED 🙇‍♀️ saying they did the very best they could with the knowledge they had at the TIME 🕒 but that doesn't bring back all the lives LOST 💀!!

This Tuesday's massive document DROP 📦 finally resolves a lawsuit brought by the advocacy group 9/11 Health Watch 🩺 who had to SUE ⚖️ the city after officials claimed they didn't even HAVE 📦 the records which is wild!! City workers only found 68 📦 boxes of these papers last year and they're being released through an online portal right before the 25th anniversary 🕯️ of the attacks with more files still coming over the next YEAR 📆!! Karen Klingon whose brother lived five minutes from Ground Zero developed asthma then cancer and died at 61 of a related brain tumor told the BBC her family is hoping this helps other sick people and FUTURE generations understand what was really in that AIR 🌬️!! Phil Alvarez whose brother Luis died of cancer in 2019 after breathing those Ground Zero toxins said people continue to get SICK 🤒 every single day and continue to DIE ☠️ which is the real tragic LEGACY 🪦 of all those LIES 🤥!!
